located_primary_sources.overlap: Current finite-interval screw-operator and Weil-form framework. The present calculation imports its completed-source setting; the paper does not supply the sought inverse-free old-to-collar compatibility factor.

local_formula_search.delta: R184 derived the four-Cauchy normal form. R185 computes both exterior sides, finds the one-mode root-filter cancellation, and corrects scalar bulk covariance to commuting pullbacks plus a projection boundary cocycle. It does not serialize the split finite-part old operator or complete global compatibility.
local_formula_search.no_identity_found: No local report or indexed primary source in this bounded search supplied a zeta-specific recurrence forcing the R185 exterior readout to vanish on the old kernel.
